title: Daily digest: After Harish Rao criticism, CM seeks fee | CPI(M) and Congress skirmish over 'hasty | South Africa votes as ANC faces further
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: After Harish Rao criticism, CM has sought feedback on school uniforms.
CPI(M) and Congress skirmish over 'hasty issuance' of liquor licences in Keralam.
South Africa votes as ANC faces further losses and coalition rule looms.
bullets_ur: Harish Rao ki tanqeed ke baad CM ne school uniforms par feedback talab kar liya
CPI(M) aur Congress Keralam mein liquor licences ke 'jald-bazi mein ajra' par aamne saamne.
South Africa mein voting, ANC ko mazeed nuqsan ka samna jabke ittehadi hukumat ke imkanat barh gaye
